questions.stem: A patient presented with a blood pressure of 220/120 mmHg in an altered sensorium. He also had an episode of vomiting and a history of weakness on the left side of his body. Which of the following is incorrect regarding hypertensive management in this case?

options.label: A
options.text: In hemorrhagic stroke, reduce the BP to less than 160/100 mmHg with antihypertensives to prevent rebleed

options.label: B
options.text: In hemorrhagic stroke, aggressive use of IV antihypertensive if SBP > 220

options.label: C
options.text: In the ER, multiple blood pressure readings should be taken before starting antihypertensive therapy

options.label: D
options.text: In ischemic stroke, BP should be reduced to <140/90 mmHg immediately
